svg.title: AI Pioneer Program — the first youth AI literacy program in U.S. history
svg.desc: AI Pioneer Program with Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Washington: ages 11–18 build and deploy real AI systems. 33,000+ youth, 42 states, Year 4 in 2027. Pipeline: prompt, agent, app, deploy, portfolio, credential.

text.textPath: FIRST YOUTH AI LITERACY PROGRAM IN U.S. HISTORY ◆ AI PIONEER ◆

svg.text: BOYS & GIRLS CLUBS OF GREATER WASHINGTON × ZEN AI CO.
The first youth AI literacy program in United States history.
Young builders launch real, cloud-hosted agents, apps, tools and games
with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Cohere, Meta, Mistral and more.
“If it’s not deployed, it’s not finished.”
